# resear.sh
> The intelligence layer brands have been missing. AI-driven cultural sponsorship intelligence. Pre-launch. Industry invite only. India, Middle East & South East Asia.

## What this is
resear.sh maps how brands actually show up at live events, festivals, celebrity partnerships, and cultural community moments — including the off-record activations, ambient sponsorships, and unofficial cultural moves that no press release or announcement service ever surfaces.

## The problem it solves
Brand sponsorship decisions are made with incomplete intelligence. Announced deals are the visible surface. The most strategically significant brand-culture activity happens before announcement, off-record, or through channels that never reach mainstream media. resear.sh captures this invisible layer.

## What it does
- Profiles 1,400+ brands with living intelligence dossiers: sponsorship history, community targeting, cultural positioning strategy
- Maps 88 cultural properties (events, festivals, tours) with multi-year sponsor histories and audience psychographics
- Tracks 25 cultural tribes with values, spending patterns, and brand permission scores (how open each community is to commercial involvement)
- Detects ambient brand activations — sponsorship-like behaviour without official contracts
- Measures cultural brand positioning using LEVI (Live Entertainment Value Index) — cooperative game theory applied to sponsorship

## Founder and domain expertise
Santosh P — 15+ years scaling live entertainment across Asia. $6M to $93M in platform GMV (BookMyShow Live, 7 years), IPL franchises (KKR, Punjab Kings), NH7 Weekender (10 cities), Coldplay and U2 stadium concerts, India Maritime Week ($8M sponsorship, 53 multinationals), WAVES Summit 2025 ($600M FDI). Has operated on both sides of every sponsorship deal.

## Market
India live events: ~$1.6B (BookMyShow-EY Parthenon, March 2026). Sports sponsorship: ~$2.3B, +13.4% growth (WPP Media, March 2026). India M&E sector: ~$33B, +9% YoY (FICCI-EY, March 2026). Live events grew 44% in 2025.

## Stage and traction
Pre-launch. Working AI agent pipeline. 1,400+ brand catalog. 88 verified property passports. 25 community profiles. 918-edge knowledge graph. 108 verified shadow collision entries. Gated Wave 1 access in identification phase.
